JOS.24.11-12.text: God gave Israel victory over the nations in Canaan

JOS.24.13-13.text: God gave Israel a land and cities Israel did not build

JOS.24.14-15.text: Joshua tells Israel to choose, and he will serve the LORD

JOS.24.16-18.text: The people promise to serve the LORD, who saved Israel

JOS.24.19-20.text: Joshua warns the people that God is holy and jealous

JOS.24.21-23.text: The people again choose to serve the LORD

JOS.24.24-26.text: Joshua makes a covenant and sets up a large stone

JOS.24.27-28.text: Joshua says the stone will witness against Israel

JOS.24.29-30.text: Joshua dies at age 110 and is buried

JOS.24.31-31.text: Israel served the LORD while Joshua and the elders lived

JOS.24.32-33.text: Joseph’s bones are buried at Shechem; Eleazar dies
